full_prompt_en: A square maximalist botanical collage is packed edge to edge with flowers, fruit, leaves, and a vividly colored peacock. The peacock occupies the upper center, its long blue-green neck rising above the flower mass and its small head turning to the left. Its body combines shimmering cobalt and teal with a striking burnt-orange wing patch and finely striped pale feathers. Around it, many species and scales of plants overlap without a single empty gap. A large coral-pink peony blooms near the lower center, its layered petals surrounding a warm yellow core. To the right sits a rounded pale rose; at left, white open blooms and narrow red-orange leaves push upward. Small yellow citrus fruit cluster beneath the bird, with cobalt-blue flowers tucked among them and dark olive foliage extending behind. The background is itself a collage of hard-edged rectangles: mustard yellow at the upper right and left middle, deep rusty red behind the bird, and a cream field with faint line drawing at the far left. These planar blocks appear between the dense natural forms, stopping the florals from becoming a uniform wallpaper. A thin black tiled or gridded strip anchors the lower edge. The surfaces vary from photographic cutout clarity to painted botanical softness and printed pattern, leaving fine veins, petal folds, feather marks, and slight paper grain visible. There is little conventional depth or cast shadow; overlapping contours and shifts in scale create a shallow, theatrical space. Saturated pink, red, yellow, teal, cobalt, and leafy green compete but are tied together by the darker base and repeated warm accents. Light is broad and even, letting every layer retain color and detail. The whole image feels abundant and deliberately crowded, its central blue figure held within a restless garden of contrasting textures and shapes.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形繁复植物拼贴由花朵、果实、叶片和色彩鲜艳的孔雀从边到边填满。孔雀占据上部中央，长长的蓝绿色颈子从花群中升起，小脑袋转向左侧。身体把闪亮钴蓝与青绿同醒目的焦橙色翅片、细条纹浅色羽毛组合起来。周围许多种类、许多尺度的植物互相叠压，没有单一空隙。一朵大珊瑚粉牡丹在下方中央开放，层叠花瓣围着暖黄色花心。右边是一朵圆浑浅粉玫瑰；左侧，白色张开的花与狭长红橙叶片向上伸展。小黄柑橘聚在鸟身下方，钴蓝花夹在其中，深橄榄绿叶丛向后延伸。背景自身也是硬边矩形拼贴：右上和左中为芥黄，鸟后为深铁锈红，最左缘则是带淡线描的奶油色域。这些平面块从密集自然形体间露出，阻止花群成为均一壁纸。下缘由一条细黑瓷砖或网格带压住。表面在摄影剪贴般清晰与绘画植物图般柔和、印刷图案之间变化，仍可看到细叶脉、花瓣褶、羽纹和轻纸纹。传统纵深或投影很少；叠压轮廓与尺度变化形成浅薄、舞台般的空间。饱和粉、红、黄、青绿、钴蓝与叶绿彼此竞争，又被较暗底部和反复出现的暖色点缀联结。光线宽广均匀，让每层都保留色彩与细节。整幅画丰盛而有意拥挤，中央蓝色主体被一座纹理形状互相对照、躁动的花园围住。
style_prompt_en: A maximalist mixed-media collage fills nearly every part of the square with layered forms of unequal scale. Saturated coral, rose, mustard, cobalt, turquoise, and olive green jostle over a scaffold of hard-edged warm rectangles and a thin dark lower band. Large rounded forms in the lower region balance a slimmer upward accent near center; many smaller clusters and pointed marks weave between them. Photographic cutout edges, softly painted transitions, decorative print texture, and faint line-work coexist, making the surface deliberately heterogeneous. Occlusion creates a shallow stage of overlapping planes rather than deep perspective. Almost no blank ground remains, yet small glimpses of flat background color separate the dense groups and keep individual silhouettes readable. Broad neutral lighting maintains detail in both bright and dark colors, with little reliance on cast shadow. The eye moves continually between bright warm blooms of color, a cool central vertical, and fine peripheral marks. The cumulative impression is lush, ornamental, and crowded without surrendering a clear internal balance.
style_prompt_zh: 繁复的混合媒介拼贴以尺度不等的层叠形体填满方形画面几乎所有部分。饱和珊瑚、玫瑰粉、芥黄、钴蓝、青绿与橄榄绿在硬边暖色矩形骨架和一条细暗下缘之上互相推挤。下部的大型圆浑形体平衡靠近中央一道更瘦的向上点缀；许多小簇群与尖形笔痕在其间穿插。摄影剪贴边缘、柔和绘画过渡、装饰性印刷纹理与淡线描并存，使表面刻意异质。遮挡建立浅舞台般叠压平面，而非深透视。几乎没有空白底色，但平面背景色的小片露出将密集团块分开，仍能辨认各自剪影。宽广中性光让亮暗色都保留细节，很少依赖投影。视线不断在明亮暖色团、冷色中央竖线与周边细痕之间移动。累积印象葱茏、装饰且拥挤，却没有放弃清楚的内部平衡。
theme_en: A richly layered peacock, flowers and fruit in an ornamental maximalist collage
theme_zh: 孔雀、花朵与果实层叠的华丽繁复拼贴
name: Maximalist composition
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
